scenes.voice: Banyak orang bilang, hasil AI itu masih biasa aja.
scenes.visual: Use the real pale blue-white supplied background edge-to-edge. A small ORIGINAL AI PRENEUR wordmark sits in the upper safe area. A 2-line typographic monolith occupies center-left, with hairline crop marks and an intentionally empty right side. Negative space is generous.
scenes.motion: 0.00–0.20s: live background and one thin line; 0.20–0.65s: mask-reveal first line via shallow diagonal clipping; 0.62–1.40s: second line exposes in two precisely offset word groups; 1.40–3.65s: a restrained shift of typographic depth and traveling hairline, not idle bounce; last 0.38s: second-line mask becomes the next scene split. Cubic-out for entry; smoothstep for settle.
scenes.handoff: First headline partitions into left/right comparison rails; image background never cuts to black.
scenes.sfx: One subtle low soft accent at main thesis reveal; only if source license is verified.

scenes.voice: Padahal masalahnya sering bukan di AI-nya.
scenes.visual: Create a split BEFORE/AFTER concept using the SAME neutral typographic sample, not invented product claims: left = flat static type and broken spacing; right = a refined, aligned motion grid. Floating narrow navy dividers give direction. Headline is anchored top-left of the main content zone.
scenes.motion: First 0.45s the existing rails hinge apart; next 0.45s two sides resolve with masked vertical windows. Within following 1.5s an example on right animates cleanly from wireframe to composed grid while left holds flat. No abrupt camera spins. Last 0.35s the right rail becomes the keynote underline in S03.
scenes.handoff: Right-side refined rule line extends into the S03 headline baseline.
scenes.assets: background_portrait, abstract CSS/SVG typography only, VOICE KE 2
scenes.sfx: Tiny pane lock/click at the clean-right reveal.

scenes.voice: Masalahnya ada di arahan yang diberikan.
scenes.visual: Show one giant headline left-biased. Under it, a long thin guide line with 3 moving control nodes implies explicit creative direction. Restrained perspective layers reinforce clarity.
scenes.motion: At start a line inherited from S02 draws across an invisible baseline (0.35s). Headline emerges using independent word masks with 0.07s stagger, NOT flying from the bottom. Control nodes move to fixed grid anchors, then stop. Last 0.35s guide line folds neatly into the structural frame of S04.
scenes.handoff: Guide line becomes the three precision tiers/steps, no full-frame flash.
scenes.assets: background_portrait, generated SVG rules/nodes, VOICE KE 3
scenes.sfx: Single soft interface-confirmation tick when guide nodes align.

scenes.voice: AI itu cepat, tapi hasilnya mengikuti seberapa jelas brief-nya.
scenes.visual: A vertical precision ladder: three increasingly refined abstract modules, WITHOUT extra unreadable labels. Graphic 1 = one vague bar; graphic 2 = aligned instructions; graphic 3 = finished visual arrangement. Supporting copy is prominent and positioned away from modules.
scenes.motion: Unfold three modules successively from a single shared center pivot over 0.95s, then sweep a slim focus indicator sequentially. The final module assembles into a crisp composition using a 0.55s constrained morph of rectangles (not fake content). Hold while VO lands. The final module opens into the prompt editor for S05.
scenes.handoff: Third module frame stretches smoothly into one large prompt field.
scenes.sfx: Very light focus snaps at the three meaningful completion points.

scenes.voice: Jadi bukan cuma bilang, bikin yang keren.
scenes.visual: One bespoke prompt-input canvas with large readable generic instruction. One empty detail column communicates a missing brief via whitespace and structural placeholders—not fake textual errors or faux software brand. Only quoted words are legible.
scenes.motion: Prompt canvas grows out of S04 module at start; cursor/typing effect is restrained and finishes within ~0.65s. Brief moment of near-stillness to communicate vagueness. Detail rows remain unfilled, and the quoted instruction scales down to dock at upper-left before S06.
scenes.handoff: The raw prompt remains as small anchor while structured direction enters, proving an upgrade.
scenes.assets: background_portrait, generated clean prompt panel, VOICE KE 5
scenes.sfx: One understated keyboard note, not exaggerated typing.

scenes.voice: Tapi menjelaskan style, ritme, komposisi, transisi, dan hierarki.
scenes.visual: Prompt architecture forms an exquisite system diagram: five typographic labels following a left-aligned spine. Each label controls a nearby live miniature graphic: font treatment, rhythmic motion bars, responsive grid, connective transitioning shape, and reading-order emphasis. Never stack five generic identical cards.
scenes.motion: 0.0–0.35s thesis repositions; each named category starts after its spoken cue (approximate at scene-local 0.7, 1.65, 2.6, 3.55, 4.5s; verify against actual VO), initially appears via mask and activates its own meaningful graphic. Animate a line traveling between modules, not five separate fly-ins. At local 5.2–5.8s all five align into a unified prompt schematic. Last 0.3s the graphic compresses to become S07 transformation input.
scenes.handoff: Unified system sends a guided blue line directly to the BEFORE/AFTER axis.
scenes.sfx: Only 2–3 deliberate ticks at meaningful reveals; no whoosh per keyword.

scenes.voice: Karena prompt yang tepat bisa mengubah output secara drastis.
scenes.visual: A continuous comparative object demonstration of the same 2D composition evolving from a cramped text block to a polished cinematic typographic layout. A slender cause-to-effect line travels LEFT TO RIGHT. The right side is an actual animated result, not a screenshot/fake product demo.
scenes.motion: First 0.45s central prompt token enters and settles. From 0.6–2.4s a controlled sweep progresses across the comparison boundary; rectangle spacing, typography masks and line density mutate deterministically. At 2.4–4.0s the premium side performs 2 complementary motions—a staggered reveal and a masked object pivot—to prove visual capability. Last 0.4s camera shifts subtly into the now-dominant premium side.
scenes.handoff: The AFTER side scales into the full canvas without changing the supplied background.
scenes.sfx: One precision transformation soft impact, no stock explosive riser.

scenes.voice: Dari teks biasa, menjadi motion yang terlihat mahal.
scenes.visual: This is the showcase beat. One central typographic hero, moving orchestrated borders, intentional depth, component-level parallax, numerical-free diagrams and edge-aligned micro-panels. Do not invent dashboards, brands, statistics or labels. Gradient headline is exceptionally clean and spacious.
scenes.motion: Entry as inherited BEFORE/AFTER sample expands (0.4s); mask cuts reveal the top headline; hero second headline emerges through shared boundary geometry (0.55–1.25s). During 1.2–3.6s execute a designed 4-part movement: hairline follows a spline-like rectilinear path, nested frame resolves, iconless blocks travel in stagger, and camera drifts <3% to reinforce space. Movement finishes at VO payoff. At exit, all components move outward to expose centered logo.
scenes.handoff: Graphic elements clear a brand-safe zone; never pretend shapes generate the true logo.
scenes.assets: background_portrait, generated abstract motion graphics, VOICE KE 8
scenes.sfx: Restrained cinematic accent on final result lock.

scenes.voice: Dan inilah cara AI PRENEUR mengarahkan AI.
scenes.visual: Center-left brand wordmark appears from the actual transparent logo asset with exact proportions. A single thin brand-line tracks underneath. Copy remains highly legible; no random glyphs morph into the logo. White–blue background remains consistent.
scenes.motion: 0–0.4s previous shapes leave via precise paths; 0.35–0.85s logo fades/reveals under one clean mask in its actual image geometry; at 0.85–1.55s copy resolves in two steps. Last 1.0s line draws rightward and plants three future nodes for S10.
scenes.handoff: Underline branches to three benefit modules while original logo stays preserved and unclipped.
scenes.assets: background_portrait, ORIGINAL logo trimmed, VOICE KE 9
scenes.sfx: Brand reveal has a single low understated accent if rights verified.

scenes.voice: Lebih cepat, lebih terarah, dan hasilnya jauh lebih premium.
scenes.visual: Three statements arranged sequentially as an architectural vertical editorial layout. EACH claim shows a distinct graphic cue rather than generic cards: CEPAT = one line resolves in a swift controlled path; TERARAH = nodes snap into deliberate grid order; PREMIUM = final meticulous alignment with quiet border highlights. They are design claims, not quantified business performance promises.
scenes.motion: First concept becomes focal in 0–1.2s, second takes priority in 1.2–2.6s, third completes from 2.6–4.4s; keep earlier statements visible at reduced emphasis. Link all movements through a single continuous line from S09. Last ~0.4s reduce visual clutter so close can breathe.
scenes.handoff: Three graphic motifs contract towards one horizontal brand baseline; no collision.
scenes.assets: background_portrait, brand logo small if composition allows, VOICE KE 10
scenes.sfx: One gentle snap per concept completion (maximum three).

scenes.voice: AI bisa membuat motion selevel ini, asal prompt-nya tepat.
scenes.visual: Clean spacious endcard using the REAL AI PRENEUR wordmark at top of central safe area. Three lines of closing statement occupy central-left/center alignment with strong hierarchy. Deep navy–steel blue gradient only on hero phrase; body solid navy. No website/handle or extra claims unless provided.
scenes.motion: 0–0.45s carry three graphic motifs into one thin underline. 0.4–1.45s headline reveals via tiered masks; 1.25–2.1s last line draws in with a rare restrained letter-group stagger. Brand lockup holds genuinely still for at least the final 0.82s after the voice ends (~47.18 to 48.0). Do NOT fade to black or abruptly remove the logo.
scenes.handoff: Final frame at 48.0s contains clean stable branded composition.
scenes.assets: background_portrait, ORIGINAL logo trimmed, VOICE KE 11
scenes.sfx: Optional soft resolve around last line, then silence for readable branded end.

typography.font_license_policy: Verify authentic locally installed/licensed fonts; no font assets included in archive; no silent fallback or synthetic bold
